description: Flight Deck lifecycle reporting. Every command quotes ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}: in production it expands to /Applications/Flight Deck.app/... and Claude Code runs hook commands through a shell, so unquoted it splits at the space and every hook dies with 127. See scripts/record.sh. record.sh prints nothing to stdout, so the PermissionRequest hook makes no permission decision and cannot race Plannotator's PermissionRequest hook. The module is Flight Control's usage meter; see hooks/register.ts.
